newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austrian shares close up, seen trapped in range.
newsitem.headline: Austrian shares close up, seen trapped in range.

text.p: Austrian shares clawed back ground after earlier losses on Wednesday, pulled up by foreign buying orders, and were expected to remain rangebound between 1,120 to 1,140 points in the short-term, traders said.
"There's no question about it, we're looking bullish until Christmas," one said.
Another predicted the ATX index of 21 blue chips could touch 1,150 points by the end of the year.
"But 1,150 is as high as it's going to go," he noted.
The ATX index edged up 2.74 points or 0.24 percent to close at 1,132.67. Seven ATX shares rose while 14 fell.
High-grade steelmaker Boehler Uddeholm was the top gainer, adding 2.61 percent to 787 schillings.
The leading decliner was heavyweight insurer EA Generali, which fell 0.83 percent to 3,570 schillings.
The broad-based Vienna Bourse index inched down 0.11 points or 0.03 percent to 427.22.
The December ATX future climbed 2.2 points to 1,131.0.
